         <video:thumbnail_loc>https://i.ytimg.com/vi/N90RuK1NMcA/mqdefault.jpg</video:thumbnail_loc> 
         <video:title>Top Acne Myths & Facts with Dermatologist Dr. Ted Lain - Part 1 | CeraVe</video:title>
         <video:description>Part 2: https://youtu.be/lhKQ1bhq2dE

As the most common skin condition in the US, acne effects more than 50 million Americans -- but there are many misconceptions surrounding its causes and treatments. 

We spoke to Dr. Ted Lain, board-certified dermatologist, to dispel some of the most common acne myths he hears from his patients:

0:17 - I need strong products to clear my face.

0:30 - I’ve tried tons of acne treatments. They’re all pretty much the same.

0:44 - I don’t need to moisturize. My skin is oily.

1:07 - My skin is super dry. I shouldn’t even have acne.

1:30 - I always keep my skin clean. I don’t understand why I have acne.

1:44 - If I change my diet, my acne will go away.

         <video:title>Understanding the Different Types of Acne | CeraVe Skincare</video:title>
         <video:description>Understanding the different types of acne is key to finding an effective treatment plan. ✅ Board-certified dermatologist & #CeraVePartner Dr. Shari Marchbein is here to explain what you need to know about acne and how to treat it. 

One of the best ways to minimize acne is with a proactive (and consistent) skincare routine that incorporates products containing ingredients such as salicylic acid. A hydrating acne cleanser—like CeraVe Acne Control Cleanser—is a great way to start the day and help clear clogged pores. At bedtime, follow with CeraVe Acne Control Gel—a hydrating salicylic acid gel acne treatment with AHA and BHA—to help clear acne and prevent new blemishes from forming. After cleansing, always make sure to apply an oil-free, non-comedogenic moisturizer (like CeraVe's AM and PM Facial Moisturizing Lotions) that contains beneficial ingredients like hyaluronic acid, ceramides, and niacinamide.

         <video:description>Board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry answers some of the most popular sunscreen questions:
• What’s the difference between chemical and mineral sunscreen?
• How often should I apply sunscreen?
• Do I need to reapply?
